description: This file provides Persian (Farsi) localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, specifically version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translations for various UI messages used within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to delete excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to enter more characters when input is below minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message indicating search is in progress.
